description: This file defines the SharedBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which facilitates inter-process shared memory communication with semaphore-based synchronization. It includes class definitions, constructors, and methods for managing shared buffers, including producer and consumer roles, and handles platform-specific semaphore implementations.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class for shared memory buffer with semaphore synchronization, supporting producer and consumer roles for inter-process communication.

classes.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore
classes.description: A platform-specific semaphore wrapper used for synchronization between processes.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[])
methods.description: Constructor for the consumer role, initializing shared buffer with a name.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[], const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const uint16_t administrationSize)
methods.description: Constructor for the producer role, setting mode, buffer size, and administration size.

methods.name: RequestProduce
methods.description: Requests lock on the producer semaphore with a wait time.

methods.name: Produced
methods.description: Signals that data has been produced and updates bytes written.

methods.name: RequestConsume
methods.description: Requests lock on the consumer semaphore with a wait time.

methods.name: Consumed
methods.description: Signals that data has been consumed and updates bytes written.

methods.name: AdministrationBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the administration buffer.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to the buffer.
